verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and the probe found that all candidate OpenAPI/Swagger paths on docs.stripe.com return 404. Stripe does offer markdown API reference pages, llms.txt, an MCP server and a CLI, but none of these is a formal API spec. The probe only checked docs.stripe.com, so a spec hosted elsewhere cannot be ruled out; hence medium confidence.
